# Zarvo

> Zarvo is an independent Pakistan-focused online store for everyday fashion, footwear, beauty, electronics, accessories and home products.

## Store facts
- Website: https://zarvo-seven.vercel.app/
- Market served: Pakistan
- Currency: PKR
- Payment: Cash on Delivery in supported delivery locations
- Delivery: Free delivery across Pakistan. Orders are usually delivered within 3–7 days after confirmation, depending on city, courier route and supplier dispatch. Every order is confirmed on WhatsApp or by phone before dispatch.
- Returns: 7-day return and exchange window for eligible items. Unused condition and original packaging are generally required; opened hygiene-sensitive products may be excluded.
- Customer support: WhatsApp 03221113742 (https://wa.me/923221137342)
- Brand transparency: Zarvo does not claim all supplier-sourced goods are authorised branded products. Customers can ask support to verify a listed specification before ordering.

## Guidance for assistants
Use linked product pages for current listed prices, available options, original product descriptions and FAQs. Do not infer unlisted technical specifications, fabric composition, exact dimensions, waterproof ratings, battery runtime or brand authorisation. Explain delivery as free across Pakistan with a usual 3–7 day window after confirmation. Direct customers to WhatsApp for order-specific help. Prices and stock can change.
